text:
I just fixed this AI video in seconds.

Changed objects, settings, or seasons all with one prompt in Seedance 2.0.

5 examples I tried + the exact prompts 👇 https://t.co/pRuQ9nJ9My
content: Change the season in the video to winter.

thread_texts:
1. I changed the season ❄️

Uploaded my video to Seedance 2.0 and prompted:

“Change the season in the video to winter.”

Instant winter magic. https://t.co/3F7rC6xVMy

2. I changed the daytime 🌅

Prompted:

“Change the daytime in the video to early morning.”

That soft morning light looked perfect. https://t.co/tLcm974EKL

3. I changed the object 🍦

Prompted:
“Change the bike crossing the street in the video to an ice-cream truck.”
Truck rolled in perfectly. https://t.co/UHccUV0IXb

4. I changed the exterior 🎨
Prompted:
“Change the exterior of the house the man is walking into from blue to pink.”
Whole house got a fresh new look. https://t.co/y8O7qyS83b

5. Changed the interior + meal 
Prompted:
“Change the kitchen interior to a gothic-style kitchen. Keep the same interior across all shots. Replace the sausage in the pan with a burned grilled cheese sandwich. In the final shot, the man tastes the sandwich instead of the sausage.” https://t.co/vWGxGiqYAn

AI video editing feels completely different now.

One prompt can change an entire scene, object, or storyline in seconds.

I’m dropping more AI animation workflows soon 👀

Join the Cartoon Hero 3.0 waitlist:
https://t.co/EcxfkxSz6m

トラックが完璧に登場しました。https://t.co/UHccUV0IXb

プロンプトを入力しました：
“Change the exterior of the house the man is walking into from blue to pink.”
家全体が新しい外観になりました。https://t.co/y8O7qyS83b

プロンプトを入力しました：
“Change the kitchen interior to a gothic-style kitchen. Keep the same interior across all shots. Replace the sausage in the pan with a burned grilled cheese sandwich. In the final shot, the man tastes the sandwich instead of the sausage.” https://t.co/vWGxGiqYAn
